root_cause: The openvino_tests artifact downloaded by both CPU test jobs does not contain the CPU plugin test binaries (ov_cpu_unit_tests and ov_cpu_func_tests). The openvino_tests artifact (ID: 8749969858) was successfully downloaded and extracted, but the CPU-specific test executables were absent from the archive. This strongly indicates that the build/packaging step for PR #36246 (branch cecilia/transpose_split_fuse) omitted or failed to install the CPU plugin test targets into the install directory, likely due to a CMake change in the PR that altered what gets included in the tests package.
reproduction_steps: N/A - requires the build artifact from this specific PR run
recommended_actions: Inspect the build job logs for PR #36246 to determine if ov_cpu_unit_tests and ov_cpu_func_tests were built and installed
Check if PR #36246 modifies CMakeLists.txt or install() rules for CPU plugin test targets
Review the build artifact (openvino_tests) content listing from the build job to confirm if CPU test binaries are present
Re-trigger the pipeline after fixing any CMake packaging issue
prevention_strategies: Add a validation step after the build that checks required CPU test binaries exist in the install directory before proceeding to test jobs. CI could also validate artifact contents at packaging time.
historical_context: This appears to be the first occurrence of CPU test binaries missing from the openvino_tests artifact in this investigation database.
